subject: Workspace control-plane provisioning sync: access, keys, and roles
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Gomes <sofia.gomes@healthly.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Workspace control-plane provisioning sync: access, keys, and roles

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier this week. Per our discussion, next week is the best window to seed your workspace and hand off the initial admin keys so your infra team can run smoke tests. Proposed plan below (short):

- Tue 2028-07-25 10:00 PT: 30m provisioning call (Jonas + Monica + your infra lead)
- Seed: create one project namespace, two service accounts (integration + operator), and one admin user
- Keys: we will upload ephemeral API keys for operator and a scoped integration key for testing (Docs attached)
- Roles: provide an initial role matrix (attached) with suggested least-privilege bindings
- Audit: enable request-level audit logs and a 30-day retention for the trial workspace

Attachments: redwood-initial-keying-instructions.pdf, initial-role-matrix.xlsx (see summaries in body of PDF).

Please confirm: 1) your infra point-of-contact for the 10:00 PT call, and 2) whether Healthly prefers keys rotated automatically after 7 days or manual rotation.

If that time doesn't work, we can do Thu 07/27 morning PT.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Sofia Gomes <sofia.gomes@healthly.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@healthly.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Workspace control-plane provisioning sync: access, keys, and roles

Jonas — thanks for the clear plan. Diego (our SRE) will be on the call. Tue 10:00 PT works.

Two quick clarifications before the call:
1) For the "integration" key, will that allow model inference calls only, or can it also read workspace config? We want it scoped to inference-only for safety.
2) For automatic rotation: we prefer automatic rotation after 7 days for ephemeral operator keys, but the integration key should be long-lived (until we switch to our KMS). Can you confirm how long-lived keys are created and where we should store them?

Appreciate the attachments — will review.

Thanks,
Sofia 
Sofia Gomes
Director of Platform Operations, Healthly Inc.
sofia.gomes@healthly.com | +1 (617) 555-0246

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jul 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Workspace control-plane provisioning sync: access, keys, and roles

Folks — prepping runbook for the Tue 10:00 call. Draft plan and ops checklist below for internal alignment (please add comments inline in the Drive folder):

Ops checklist (internal):
- Pre-provision: confirm Healthly org ID and billing contact (Jonas to verify on call)
- Create project namespace: healthly-prod-trial-1 (Ben)
- Service accounts:
  * healthly-integration-sa — restricted to model:generate and embeddings:list
  * healthly-operator-sa — admin-scoped but ephemeral (rotate after 7d)
- API Keys: generate two keys; upload the operator key to the trial workspace as ephemeral; provide integration key as plaintext in the provisioning email with KMS onboarding note
- Roles: apply role bindings from initial-role-matrix.xlsx (attached). Minimal recommended changes for Healthly are noted in column D.
- Audit & retention: turn on request-level logging; retention set to 30 days; export destination: gs://healthly-redwood-logs (customer-managed).
- Post-provision: run smoke script (scripts/provision-smoke.sh) and share results to Healthly slack channel (#healthly-infra).

Attachments included for Tue: initial-role-matrix.xlsx. I also uploaded a short PDF that summarizes key differences between ephemeral and scoped keys. Jonas, confirm you'll include KMS onboarding steps and the Drive link in the provisioning email. Ben, can you take project create and service account tasks?

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@healthly.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Workspace control-plane provisioning sync: access, keys, and roles

Hi Sofia and Diego — thanks for joining this morning. Quick summary of outcomes and next steps (short):

1) Agreed scope:
 - Integration key: inference-only (no config or admin reads). We'll scope it to the model.generate and embeddings endpoints.
 - Operator key: ephemeral admin key; automatic rotation = 7 days.

2) Deliverables (internal owners):
 - Project namespace creation: Ben (healthly-prod-trial-1) — completed 2028-07-25 12:07 PT
 - Keys: Ben uploaded operator ephemeral key to the workspace and pasted the integration key into Healthly-secure-share (see Drive link)
 - Roles applied: Monica validated the role bindings; initial-role-matrix.xlsx updated with final bindings
 - Audit export: Healthly will provision the gs://healthly-redwood-logs bucket; Diego to share bucket IAM

3) Follow-ups for Healthly:
 - Diego: share the GCS bucket IAM and confirm the KMS team contact for long-lived key rotation plan
 - Sofia: confirm SRE test results by EOD Thu 07/27 (post-smoke run)

Attachments: redwood-initial-keying-instructions.pdf, initial-role-matrix.xlsx (finalized).

If anything is off or if Healthly wants the operator key TTL shortened while they test, we can change it immediately. Otherwise we'll schedule the next checkpoint in two weeks to review metrics and cost.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
